# ⚠️ Important Security Notice

**Please DO NOT post public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.**

To report a vulnerability responsibly:
1. Use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/ardianryan/DigiSignPro-SelfPDFQRSign/security/advisories/new)
2. Or email our security contact directly at: **security@ppti.me**

For more information, please read our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md).
